source_type: own release (Supplementary Information of Omiye et al., npj Digit Med 2023) parsed with the MedHELM/HELM loader
revision: npj Digital Medicine ESM MOESM1; HELM 63754d05db6f874e41a395880fb573890a13e791
license: CC BY 4.0 (npj Digital Medicine open-access article)
split: test (HELM uses all items as test)
request_fields: HELM prompt: instruction to answer A (harmful/inaccurate/race-based) or B + Question + Response (an LLM answer from the supplement)
notes: The docx holds Bard, ChatGPT, Claude and GPT-4 responses (5 runs each) to the paper's questions. HELM's parser yields 171 runs (labels: 86 True, 85 False) and 167 unique question-response prompts, which become the HELM instances. The original study had 9 questions; parsed question strings vary in wording (29 distinct). EquityMedQA also redistributes the 9 Omiye questions (other_datasets_omiye_et_al.csv), but those are questions only, not the MedHELM item format. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: template: MedHELM race_based_med prompt (scenario text "For the following question-answer pair ... Question: ... Response: ..." inside the HELM multiple-choice-joint adapter with options A. yes / B. no and the output cue)
